Play Sigma Star Saga DX now on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/sigma-star-saga-dx-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01  

A classic shooter/RPG returns new and improved! Side-scrolling space-shooter battles meet top-down exploration in this sci-fi epic featuring more than 15,000 Gun Data combinations. Infiltrate the invading alien empire, investigate six planets, power up with awesome tools, and enjoy bonus features like an art gallery and jukebox. The fate of the stars is in your hands!
